english.title: Cause / permit fail to maintain and make available documentation re reared meat chicken production system - England
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse, caused or permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person responsible for conventionally reared meat chickens, to fail to maintain and, on request, make available to the Secretary of State, documentation in the house giving a detailed description of the production systems in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(1)(ba), 7(1)(c) and 9 of, and paragraph 5(a) of Schedule 5A to, the Welfare of Farmed Animals (England) Regulations 2007.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, without lawful authority or excuse, caused or permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person responsible for conventionally reared meat chickens, to fail to maintain and, on request, make available to the Secretary of State, documentation in the house giving a detailed description of the production systems in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..).

other.penalty:
Summary: 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 51 weeks imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation
